items.title: 补充 MemoryScore 100 分制计算公式
items.context: 当前文档已有 Memory Recall Validation Contract，但缺少用户确认的细化评分权重。需要在 Scoring and thresholds 附近加入权重表、公式、硬失败条件，并说明权重不是任意优化而是 baseline 证明记忆能力。
items.userSees: "MemoryScore = 25 * HistoricalRetrievalScore + 25 * ExactAnswerHit + 25 * EvidenceLinkageRate + 15 * LayerRoutingAccuracy + 10 * ScaleStabilityScore" appears in Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md, and HistoricalRetrievalScore includes exact recall@1, recall@10, MRR@10, and precision@10.

happy.desc: 文档新增 MemoryScore 100 分公式，并把 exact recall@1、recall@10、MRR@10、precision@10 纳入 HistoricalRetrievalScore 子项。

edge.desc: 公式必须保留原有阈值语义：exact recall@1 目标 1.0，recall@10 >= 0.90，MRR@10 >= 0.75，precision@10 >= 0.70；低于阈值仍是 contract-level fail。

adversarial.desc: 新增权重不得把 retrieval 分数或 benchmark score 升格为 Koala lifecycle truth、validation evidence 或 production authority。

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "MemoryScore \(100-point baseline\)|HistoricalRetrievalScore =|exact recall@1 \+ recall@10 \+ MRR@10 \+ precision@10|QualityScore =|25 \* HistoricalRetrievalScore|25 \* ExactAnswerHit|25 \* EvidenceLinkageRate|15 \* LayerRoutingAccuracy|10 \* ScaleStabilityScore" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: MemoryScore section is present; HistoricalRetrievalScore includes exact recall@1, recall@10, MRR@10, and precision@10; QualityScore and MemoryScore weights are present.
Covers original retrieval thresholds, 10k/100k/1M MemoryScore thresholds, and the staleTruthHit failure taxonomy for current-state stale truth hard fail.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "MemoryScore is not Koala lifecycle truth|Benchmark PASS can only be future implementation validation evidence|million-candidate harness" Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md; git show --check --stat --oneline HEAD -- Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md
verificationEvidence.note: The scoring formula is explicitly bounded as future validation evidence only, and the committed document patch has no git show --check issues.

items.title: 补充评分结果的权威边界说明
items.context: 在 Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md 的评分 baseline 附近写清楚 MemoryScore 只能证明 future memory implementation 的 recall correctness，不能替代 Koala lifecycle truth、review pass、validation evidence、delivery check、receipt 或 production authority；这是用户可直接读到的正文边界，而不是内部验证口号。
items.userSees: "MemoryScore is not Koala lifecycle truth, review pass, validation evidence, delivery check, receipt, or production authority" appears near the scoring formula in Lattice-lifecycle-memory-Evolving.md.

happy.desc: 文档在 MemoryScore 附近新增 score boundary，说明分数用于 future memory implementation recall correctness。

edge.desc: 文档必须说明 10k/100k/1M 的 score thresholds 是 baseline/stress validation，不代表当前已实现 million-candidate harness。

adversarial.desc: 文档不得出现把 MemoryScore、benchmark PASS、host transcript 或 advisory memory 当成 gate evidence / production authority 的正向语义。

verificationEvidence.note: The scoring section states MemoryScore is a narrow future-memory correctness score and not lifecycle truth or production authority.
